label: India: CDSCO

categories.label: Level IV: record of change
categories.rule: Implement and keep the record under GMP; mention it in the next submission.

categories.label: Level III: annual notification
categories.rule: Implement, then report in the annual notification in the first quarter of the next calendar year; supply data within 30 days if asked.

categories.label: Post-approval change application (case by case)
categories.rule: Apply to CDSCO through SUGAM and implement only when CDSCO agrees.

categories.label: Level III, approval needed first (shelf life)
categories.rule: A minor change, but shelf-life changes need a post-approval change application and approval before use.

categories.label: Administrative change: approval (about 30 days)
categories.rule: Needs CDSCO approval before implementation; review takes about 30 days.

categories.label: Level II: notifiable change
categories.rule: Submit with supporting data; do not implement commercially before CDSCO approves.

categories.label: Level I: supplement
categories.rule: Submit a supplement with supporting data and the fee; implement only after CDSCO approves.

categories.label: New drug permission
categories.rule: Apply for permission as a new drug (Form CT-18 or CT-21); CDSCO decides within 90 working days.

multipleChanges.rule: Each change is applied for on its own unless CDSCO agrees otherwise; related changes can be explained together in one application.

L3.label: Annual notification due in the first quarter of the next calendar year

L1.label: No fixed review time in the rules

L2.label: No fixed review time in the rules

pac.label: Covering letter stating the change category
Application with the fee receipt (TR-6 challan) on SUGAM
Copy of the marketing authorisation and an undertaking that the conditions are met

import.label: Approval of the change in the country of origin and the list of countries where it is approved

pi.label: Revised prescribing information, labels and package insert (clean and with changes marked)

annual.label: Covering letter for the annual notification
Annual report of minor changes (January to December)

newdrug.label: Application in Form CT-18 (import) or CT-21 (manufacture) with the fee receipt

ndct.title: New Drugs and Clinical Trials Rules, 2019

pac24.title: CDSCO guidance: Post Approval Changes in Biological Products: Quality, Safety and Efficacy Documents (PAC/2024)

cdsco.title: CDSCO practice for post-approval changes (SUGAM applications)

summary: Rules in force in 2026: biologicals follow CDSCO's PAC/2024 guidance (Levels I to IV); chemical drugs have no codified categories, so CDSCO decides case by case; new claims make a product a new drug again.

changeLog.text: First India edition: PAC/2024 levels for biologicals, case-by-case for chemical drugs, new drug permission for new claims.
